predict.question: Starting at 8 angle units, what follows two halvings?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Our view of Earth changes with the vantage point from which we see it.
modelBoundary: One distance doubling gives {A}; two give {B}. The second halving acts on an already smaller angle rather than subtracting a fixed amount.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This inverse-distance approximation assumes fixed object size and small angles. It is not an exact angular formula or spacecraft measurement.
